name: TMS Co.,Ltd.
summary: TMS Co., Ltd., formed in 2005 with headquarters in Fuchu, Japan, researches, develops, manufactures and commercializes pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, drug substances and medical devices. Its pipeline includes TMS-007, an SMTP congener with prothrombolytic and anti-inflammatory/antioxidative activity that has completed Phase 2a trials for acute ischemic stroke. It has a strategic alliance with Ji Xing Pharmaceuticals Limited and has agreed to research with Teikyo University.
